scope: Alternate frames and opposite streams for L17, coordinated with Claude's D/G/JOIN formalization. No edits to earlier folders or Lean sources.
predictions: Exact invertible coordinate changes preserve the complete logical raw trace when decoded.
Uniform elongation requires transformed neighbor moves; advancing by one display position generally fails.
For logical head coordinates, tau=M*t+P*x is strictly increasing along every possible defined move if M>|P|.
The six internal canonical D/G rows have at most one predecessor; output N mod10 and, at residue0, the middle parity identify it.
The combined lexicographic rank(s,l,R), R_D=3k+8m+3 and R_G=3k, decreases on each internal row, including the guarded JOIN.
F1100 entry states D(2a-12,7,2c-13;7,3) have no internal predecessor for a>=7,c>=7.
A single affine ranking with mode offsets cannot decrease on every internal D/G row for unbounded counters; the obstruction is in D1,D2,G1.
